meanings.en: lacking some necessary quality or element
meanings.exampleEn: Their diet was deficient in vitamins.
meanings.exampleTr: Beslenmeleri vitamin bakımından yetersizdi.

meanings.en: gained or developed rather than innate
meanings.exampleEn: A taste for olives is an acquired one.
meanings.exampleTr: Zeytin sevgisi sonradan edinilen bir zevktir.

meanings.en: not able to be cured or treated
meanings.exampleEn: The disease was sadly untreatable at that stage.
meanings.exampleTr: Hastalık o aşamada maalesef tedavi edilemezdi.

meanings.en: able to be cured
meanings.exampleEn: Most early cancers are curable today.
meanings.exampleTr: Erken evredeki çoğu kanser bugün tedavi edilebilir.

meanings.en: morally or legally bound to do something
meanings.exampleEn: She felt obligated to help her neighbor.
meanings.exampleTr: Komşusuna yardım etmek zorunda hissetti kendini.

meanings.en: in a self-governing or independent way
meanings.exampleEn: The robot operates autonomously without human input.
meanings.exampleTr: Robot, insan müdahalesi olmadan özerk biçimde çalışır.

meanings.en: in a manner relying on something else
meanings.exampleEn: The variables change dependently on each other.
meanings.exampleTr: Değişkenler birbirine bağımlı biçimde değişir.

meanings.en: too great or intense to be described in words
meanings.exampleEn: She felt an inexpressible joy at the news.
meanings.exampleTr: Haber karşısında tarifsiz bir sevinç hissetti.

meanings.en: too bad or horrible to express in words
meanings.exampleEn: They endured unspeakable suffering during the war.
meanings.exampleTr: Savaş sırasında ağza alınmaz acılara katlandılar.

meanings.en: to treat with excessive care and attention
meanings.exampleEn: She likes to pamper herself with a spa day.
meanings.exampleTr: Kendini bir spa günüyle şımartmayı sever.

meanings.en: allowing freedom of behavior; tolerant
meanings.exampleEn: His permissive parents rarely set any rules.
meanings.exampleTr: Hoşgörülü ailesi nadiren kural koyardı.

meanings.en: not chemically reactive or responsive
meanings.exampleEn: Noble gases are largely unreactive.
meanings.exampleTr: Soy gazlar büyük ölçüde tepkimeyen gazlardır.

meanings.en: not having or requiring special training or skill
meanings.exampleEn: Many unskilled workers were hired for the harvest.
meanings.exampleTr: Hasat için birçok vasıfsız işçi tutuldu.

meanings.en: the spread of disease by close contact
meanings.exampleEn: Doctors worked to prevent the contagion from spreading.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktorlar bulaşmanın yayılmasını önlemeye çalıştı.

meanings.en: made impure by exposure to a harmful substance
meanings.exampleEn: The villagers drank from a contaminated well.
meanings.exampleTr: Köylüler kirlenmiş bir kuyudan su içti.

meanings.en: affected by disease
meanings.exampleEn: The diseased tree had to be cut down.
meanings.exampleTr: Hastalıklı ağacın kesilmesi gerekti.

meanings.en: spread from one person to another by contact
meanings.exampleEn: Chickenpox is highly contagious among children.
meanings.exampleTr: Su çiçeği çocuklar arasında oldukça bulaşıcıdır.

meanings.en: able to be passed from one to another
meanings.exampleEn: The virus is transmittable through the air.
meanings.exampleTr: Virüs hava yoluyla bulaşabilir.

meanings.en: not capable of being spread by infection
meanings.exampleEn: Diabetes is a noninfectious disease.
meanings.exampleTr: Diyabet bulaşıcı olmayan bir hastalıktır.

meanings.en: an enlarged area of the body caused by injury or illness
meanings.exampleEn: The swelling on his ankle went down after a day.
meanings.exampleTr: Ayak bileğindeki şişlik bir gün sonra indi.

meanings.en: causing a strong reaction, especially anger
meanings.exampleEn: He made a provocative remark to start an argument.
meanings.exampleTr: Tartışma başlatmak için kışkırtıcı bir yorum yaptı.

meanings.en: tending to stir up conflict; designed to cause fire
meanings.exampleEn: His incendiary speech sparked riots in the city.
meanings.exampleTr: Kışkırtıcı konuşması şehirde ayaklanmaları tetikledi.

meanings.en: to explode or cause to explode
meanings.exampleEn: The bomb could blow up at any moment.
meanings.exampleTr: Bomba her an patlayabilirdi.

meanings.en: to let air or gas out of something
meanings.exampleEn: He had to deflate the tires before storing the bike.
meanings.exampleTr: Bisikleti kaldırmadan önce lastiklerin havasını indirmesi gerekti.

meanings.en: an act of breaking a law, rule, or agreement
meanings.exampleEn: The leak was a serious breach of security.
meanings.exampleTr: Sızıntı ciddi bir güvenlik ihlaliydi.

meanings.en: to leave property to someone in a will
meanings.exampleEn: She chose to bequeath her estate to charity.
meanings.exampleTr: Mülkünü hayır kurumuna vasiyetle bırakmayı seçti.

meanings.en: a quick sharp poke or punch
meanings.exampleEn: He gave the punching bag a swift jab.
meanings.exampleTr: Kum torbasına hızlı bir dürtme attı.

meanings.en: injured, especially by a weapon
meanings.exampleEn: The wounded soldiers were taken to a field hospital.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaralı askerler sahra hastanesine götürüldü.

meanings.en: not hurt or damaged in any way
meanings.exampleEn: Everyone escaped the crash unharmed.
meanings.exampleTr: Herkes kazadan zarar görmeden kurtuldu.

meanings.en: without causing any harm
meanings.exampleEn: The arrow flew harmlessly past his head.
meanings.exampleTr: Ok, başının yanından zararsızca geçip gitti.

meanings.en: in a manner showing lack of experience or judgment
meanings.exampleEn: He naively believed every word she said.
meanings.exampleTr: Söylediği her kelimeye saflıkla inandı.

meanings.en: in a way that shows a feeling of guilt
meanings.exampleEn: She glanced guiltily at the empty cookie jar.
meanings.exampleTr: Boş kurabiye kavanozuna suçluluk duyarak baktı.

meanings.en: unable to be divided or separated
meanings.exampleEn: They saw the nation as one indivisible whole.
meanings.exampleTr: Ulusu bölünemez tek bir bütün olarak görüyorlardı.

meanings.en: able to be separated or divided
meanings.exampleEn: These two issues are easily separable.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu iki konu kolayca ayrılabilir.

meanings.en: providing a reason or incentive to act
meanings.exampleEn: Her coach gave a motivating speech before the match.
meanings.exampleTr: Antrenörü maçtan önce motive edici bir konuşma yaptı.

meanings.en: immediately; without delay
meanings.exampleEn: Please come here at once.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen hemen buraya gel.

meanings.en: to fix or set securely, especially into the body or mind
meanings.exampleEn: Surgeons will implant a pacemaker next week.
meanings.exampleTr: Cerrahlar gelecek hafta bir kalp pili yerleştirecek.

meanings.en: to instill ideas by persistent repetition
meanings.exampleEn: Teachers try to inculcate good values in children.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmenler çocuklara iyi değerleri aşılamaya çalışır.

meanings.en: the ability to understand something instinctively
meanings.exampleEn: Her intuition told her something was wrong.
meanings.exampleTr: Sezgisi ona bir şeylerin yanlış olduğunu söylüyordu.

meanings.en: an action or remark that causes offense
meanings.exampleEn: His rude comment was an affront to the whole team.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaba yorumu tüm takıma bir hakaretti.

meanings.en: to set apart from others; to separate by group
meanings.exampleEn: The law no longer allows schools to segregate students by race.
meanings.exampleTr: Yasa artık okulların öğrencileri ırka göre ayırmasına izin vermiyor.

meanings.en: relating to the brain or intellect
meanings.exampleEn: His films have a cerebral, thought-provoking style.
meanings.exampleTr: Filmleri zihinsel, düşündürücü bir üsluba sahiptir.

meanings.en: giving full attention to one thing
meanings.exampleEn: She stayed focused throughout the long exam.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun sınav boyunca odaklanmış kaldı.

meanings.en: reacting quickly and positively
meanings.exampleEn: The new staff are very responsive to customer needs.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni personel müşteri ihtiyaçlarına çok duyarlı.

meanings.en: to interfere in something that is not your concern
meanings.exampleEn: Stop trying to meddle in my private affairs.
meanings.exampleTr: Özel işlerime burnunu sokmaya çalışmayı bırak.

meanings.en: to become involved in a situation to alter it
meanings.exampleEn: A teacher had to intervene to stop the fight.
meanings.exampleTr: Kavgayı durdurmak için bir öğretmenin araya girmesi gerekti.

meanings.en: concerning the way things are connected
meanings.exampleEn: The study examined relational patterns within families.
meanings.exampleTr: Çalışma, aileler içindeki ilişkisel örüntüleri inceledi.

meanings.en: to convert a coded message into understandable form
meanings.exampleEn: Analysts struggled to decode the secret message.
meanings.exampleTr: Analistler gizli mesajın şifresini çözmekte zorlandı.

meanings.en: to understand or explain wrongly
meanings.exampleEn: Don't misinterpret my silence as agreement.
meanings.exampleTr: Sessizliğimi onay olarak yanlış yorumlama.

meanings.en: the act of carrying something on without stopping
meanings.exampleEn: The sequel is a continuation of the original story.
meanings.exampleTr: Devam filmi, orijinal hikâyenin bir devamıdır.

meanings.en: to intrude gradually on someone's territory or rights
meanings.exampleEn: New buildings slowly encroach on the green spaces.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni binalar yavaş yavaş yeşil alanlara el atıyor.

meanings.en: a person who enters property without permission
meanings.exampleEn: The sign warned that trespassers would be prosecuted.
meanings.exampleTr: Tabela, izinsiz girenlerin cezalandırılacağını bildiriyordu.

meanings.en: a person who moves about stealthily, often with bad intent
meanings.exampleEn: A prowler was spotted near the back garden at night.
meanings.exampleTr: Gece arka bahçenin yakınında sinsice dolaşan biri görüldü.

meanings.en: the act of getting involved without invitation
meanings.exampleEn: He resented his mother's constant interference.
meanings.exampleTr: Annesinin sürekli müdahalesinden rahatsızdı.

meanings.en: remaining the same; not altering
meanings.exampleEn: The old town has an unchanging charm.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski kasabanın değişmeyen bir cazibesi var.

meanings.en: punctuation marks used to show direct speech or quotes
meanings.exampleEn: Put the spoken words inside quotation marks.
meanings.exampleTr: Söylenen sözleri tırnak işaretleri içine koy.

meanings.en: not seen or noticed
meanings.exampleEn: An unseen hand seemed to guide events.
meanings.exampleTr: Görünmeyen bir el olayları yönlendiriyor gibiydi.

meanings.tr: baştan çıkarıcı biçimde, iştah açıcı şekilde
meanings.en: in a way that attracts or tempts
meanings.exampleEn: The cakes were temptingly arranged in the window.
meanings.exampleTr: Pastalar vitrinde iştah açıcı biçimde dizilmişti.

meanings.en: in a pleasing or appealing manner
meanings.exampleEn: The room was attractively decorated for the party.
meanings.exampleTr: Oda parti için çekici biçimde süslenmişti.

meanings.en: in a way that causes disgust or aversion
meanings.exampleEn: The room smelled repellently of damp and mold.
meanings.exampleTr: Oda itici biçimde nem ve küf kokuyordu.

meanings.en: to quote or refer to as evidence
meanings.exampleEn: The author cited several studies to support her claim.
meanings.exampleTr: Yazar iddiasını desteklemek için birkaç çalışmadan alıntı yaptı.

meanings.en: to be attractive to; to make an earnest request to
meanings.exampleEn: Bright colors tend to appeal to young children.
meanings.exampleTr: Parlak renkler genellikle küçük çocukların hoşuna gider.

meanings.en: in a seemingly self-contradictory way
meanings.exampleEn: Paradoxically, the more he rested, the more tired he felt.
meanings.exampleTr: Paradoksal olarak, ne kadar dinlendiyse o kadar yorgun hissetti.

meanings.en: appealing and likely to attract
meanings.exampleEn: The offer was too tempting to refuse.
meanings.exampleTr: Teklif reddedilemeyecek kadar cazipti.

meanings.en: able to be resisted or withstood
meanings.exampleEn: The temptation proved surprisingly resistible.
meanings.exampleTr: Cazibe şaşırtıcı biçimde karşı konulabilir çıktı.

meanings.en: in a way that is powerfully convincing
meanings.exampleEn: She argued compellingly for the new policy.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni politikayı ikna edici biçimde savundu.

meanings.en: made worse or more serious; annoyed
meanings.exampleEn: He grew aggravated by the constant noise.
meanings.exampleTr: Sürekli gürültüden dolayı sinirlendi.

meanings.en: making something worse; very annoying
meanings.exampleEn: His aggravating habit of interrupting drove her mad.
meanings.exampleTr: Sözünü kesme gibi sinir bozucu alışkanlığı onu çıldırttı.

meanings.en: a person who lives on the mainland rather than an island
meanings.exampleEn: The islanders often felt misunderstood by mainlanders.
meanings.exampleTr: Adalılar çoğu zaman anakara sakinlerince yanlış anlaşıldıklarını hissederdi.

meanings.en: to feel a slight prickling or stinging sensation
meanings.exampleEn: Her fingers began to tingle in the cold.
meanings.exampleTr: Soğukta parmakları karıncalanmaya başladı.
